tests.title: Pad trigger and LED coverage
tests.why: Test actual hardware response without inventing MIDI IDs, audio tolerances or HID mappings.
steps: Check MASCHINE MK3 official manual, ports and operating mode.
Exercise all pad controls or signal routes using MIDI monitor, DJ software or external measurement as appropriate.
Repeat, save evidence and distinguish unobservable from failed hardware.
